# WP2-b: state-estimation bad-data detector on 02-Semiurban

Every 5th record of the 1 Hz IPAL state. State estimation per topology: linear WLS (linearised AC at the envelope centre) plus 1 Gauss-Newton correction(s) against the full AC model; monitored measurements (559, load P and Q included), pseudo-measurements for unmonitored load P and Q from monitored loads of the same profile, weak prior. Residual = measured minus AC model at the estimate, divided by the noise sigma; score = max |residual|; alarm when above theta = 2.0 x train 99.9th percentile for L consecutive records. Wall time 510 s.
